name: Daniel Holmes
tagline: Break-and-retest breakout scalper on Gold & NQ — streams live every day and founded his own prop firm, Oz Funded.
summary: Daniel Holmes is a full-time day trader of Gold (XAUUSD) and NQ futures who streams live every day. His documented method: 15-minute London breakout with retest, wick-flip / engulfing confirmation, pending-stop entries and a consistent 1:1 R:R — clean price action, no indicators. He founded the prop firm Oz Funded and his playbook is publicly taught in step-by-step videos (105K+ views).
oneLiner: 15m London gold breakout → retest → engulfing/closure confirmation → pending stop at the engulfing extreme → 1:1 target, live every day.
keyQuote: Watch the video below to see my trading playbook that makes me $500K every year, and how you can do the same. If you're not profitable by the end of the program, you get a full refund.
highlights: Break-and-retest breakout scalping off support and resistance zones — no indicator system documented; price action only.
Trades Gold (XAUUSD) as primary market, NQ second — most live streams are Gold sessions.
Trades live every day with real sessions streamed — transparency as a discipline mechanism.
Willing to trade news events live (e.g. a full NFP session stream).
Founded Oz Funded: his firm runs 6% target / no daily loss limit / 4% max trailing eval rules, 90% split, news allowed.
Mentorship with a full refund if the student is not profitable by the end — skin in the game.
